tweaks.summary: Turn this off to put the previous clipboard contents back after a paste action. An extension can still choose for itself with the `restore` option.
Search actions also copy the selected text. An extension can still choose for itself with the `copy` option.
When a PopClip action shows text, it also copies it.
When a link opens in the current browser, the new tab goes at the end of the tab bar instead of to the right of the current tab.
The bar always appears above or below the selection as set in Appearance, whichever way you dragged to select.
PopClip doesn't appear when a single click into a field selects its contents, such as a browser address bar.
How far the pointer can move away from the bar before it starts to dismiss.
How long the bar waits to dismiss once the pointer is beyond the dismiss distance.
The widest the bar can be, as a fraction of the screen width.
The widest the bar can be, in points. 0 means no limit.
Context-style submenus open when the pointer rests on them, not only on click.
Use the original menu bar icon.
Don't show tooltips when hovering over the bar's buttons.
Key presses don't dismiss the bar, so screenshot shortcuts can capture it.
Hide Cut and Paste when Accessibility reports that a field isn't editable. Off by default because some apps report it wrongly.
Grab the rich clipboard copy even when Accessibility already returned the text. Try this if actions lose formatting in a particular app.
Send synthetic key presses through the session event tap instead of directly to the app being acted on.
Address browsers by bundle ID only, without telling apart several running copies of the same browser by process.
Open links the standard way, without using AppleScript to place the new tab.
Don't fetch the current browser page's URL and title for actions.
Always open the bar at the top level, ignoring submenus that ask to open straight away.
Run AppleScript actions inside PopClip instead of in the separate, cancellable script runner.
Render icons fresh every time instead of using the memory and disk caches.
Don't scan JavaScript for APIs that need an entitlement. This only affects diagnostics.
Shell script actions run in a plain shell, so profile files such as `.zprofile` aren't read.
